cause.label: dilution_or_going_concern
cause.what_happened: No press release, 8-K or wire story is dated 2026-09-25 or 2026-09-28. The stock is -52% over five sessions (about $6.9 mid-September to $2.54 now, on 21x volume today), after two things. On 2026-09-18 the FDA approved Lilly's imlunestrant + abemaciclib, a direct competitor to lasofoxifene + abemaciclib in ESR1-mutated mBC. That approval also opened the 30-day exercise window (to 2026-10-19) on the $6.35 Series A warrants the company counts on for $146M. With spot at $2.54 that cash will not come, and the 10-Q carries going-concern language and says the company cannot use Form S-3. This is an inferred backdrop, not a sourced trigger for today's session.

evidence.claim: The Series A warrants (23,031,494 at $6.35, about $146.2M if exercised for cash) became exercisable on 2026-09-18 and expire on 2026-10-19; they may expire unexercised.
The exercisability trigger includes FDA approval of Lilly's imlunestrant application. The PIPE was priced at $6.35 per share, and 58.5M shares are registered for resale.
The FDA approved imlunestrant + abemaciclib for ER+/HER2-/ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer, the same population ELAINE-3 targets.

Cash and investments were $51.1M at 2026-06-30 against $37.9M of H1 operating cash burn. The 10-Q states substantial doubt about going concern, and the company cannot use S-3 or its Cantor/BTIG ATM through December 2026.
Sector backdrop: AstraZeneca's SERENA-4 (camizestrant, first line) missed its primary endpoint.

pipeline.next_dated_event: The Series A warrant exercise window closes on 2026-10-19, almost certainly unexercised at $6.35. Sermonix distributes pre-funded warrants for 2,352,932 shares to Perceptive Xontogeny on 2026-10-26. Neither falls inside the window.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A PIPE, registered direct or warrant-inducement 8-K overnight would push the number sharply lower. A Form 4 or 13D/A showing Perceptive (19.99%, Section 16) or Sermonix (36.9%) buying, or a sourced analyst defence before the open, would push it higher.

findings.finding: No at-the-market sale or shelf takedown can price tonight or tomorrow. LeonaBio cannot use Form S-3 through December 2026 because it filed an 8-K late, and its Cantor/BTIG ATM has sold zero shares and cannot currently be used (10-Q filed 2026-08-14).
findings.mechanism_in_window: The ineligibility covers the whole window (through December 2026). The commonest second leg down for a going-concern biotech after a heavy-volume fall, an ATM drip or an overnight shelf takedown, is structurally unavailable between the 09-28 close and the 09-29 close. A PIPE is still possible and is not ruled out.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None: the company has never sold under this ATM (zero shares per the 10-Q). Its last raise was the December 2025 $90M PIPE at $6.35.
findings.why_not_priced: A 21x-volume fall in a going-concern name is usually priced for an overnight raise into the weakness, and the phase-0 >15x bucket (-2.44%) is built largely from such names. This one cannot do a registered takedown in the window. If the tape knew that, the late-session supply would look like holders selling rather than front-running an offering; the difference is small and only shows if no 8-K lands tonight.
findings.independence: The SEC submissions feed shows no S-3, 424B5 or other prospectus supplement filed since the January 2026 S-3 (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001620463.json, read 2026-09-28).

outside_window.finding: The Series A warrants ($6.35, 23.0M shares, $146.2M) expire 2026-10-19 and are deep out of the money at $2.54. The funding the company presented as its runway will not arrive, so a dilutive PIPE or S-1 raise is likely but has no date.
Sermonix distributes pre-funded warrants for 2,352,932 shares to Perceptive Xontogeny Venture Fund II on 2026-10-26, a supply event in holder composition.

Going concern: $51.1M of cash at 06-30 against about $19M a quarter of burn, so roughly $32M at 09-30 by extrapolation. The Q3 10-Q (estimated 2026-11-05, a cadence prior, not a company date) will restate it.
ELAINE-3 enrollment completion (about 600 patients) is guided to 4Q 2026, with topline in 2H 2027. The Series B warrants ($7.62, 21.26M shares) only become exercisable on topline.
